linux.install: cd {{SERVERLOCATION}} && which java || (echo 'Java not found, please install JRE 17 manually')
linux.post_hook: cd {{SERVERLOCATION}} && id && ls -la . && wget --no-check-certificate -O server.jar https://piston-data.mojang.com/v1/objects/84194a2f286ef7c14ed7ce0090dba59902951553/server.jar && echo 'eula=true' > eula.txt

windows.post_hook: cd {{SERVERLOCATION}}; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri https://piston-data.mojang.com/v1/objects/84194a2f286ef7c14ed7ce0090dba59902951553/server.jar -OutFile server.jar; 'eula=true' | Out-File -Encoding ASCII eula.txt

linux.install: cd {{SERVERLOCATION}} && which java || (echo 'Java not found, please install JRE 21 manually')
linux.post_hook: cd {{SERVERLOCATION}} && wget -O BuildTools.jar https://hub.spigotmc.org/jenkins/job/BuildTools/lastSuccessfulBuild/artifact/target/BuildTools.jar && java -jar BuildTools.jar --rev 1.21.4 && find . -maxdepth 1 -name 'spigot-*.jar' | head -1 | xargs -I{} cp {} server.jar && echo 'eula=true' > eula.txt

windows.post_hook: cd {{SERVERLOCATION}}; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri https://hub.spigotmc.org/jenkins/job/BuildTools/lastSuccessfulBuild/artifact/target/BuildTools.jar -OutFile BuildTools.jar; java -jar BuildTools.jar --rev latest; Copy-Item spigot-*.jar server.jar; 'eula=true' | Out-File -Encoding ASCII eula.txt

linux.install: cd {{SERVERLOCATION}} && which java || (echo 'Java not found, please install JRE 21 manually')
linux.post_hook: cd {{SERVERLOCATION}} && NEOFORGE_VERSION=$(curl -s https://maven.neoforged.net/releases/net/neoforged/neoforge/maven-metadata.xml | grep -oP '(?<=<release>)[^<]+') && wget -O neoforge-installer.jar "https://maven.neoforged.net/releases/net/neoforged/neoforge/${NEOFORGE_VERSION}/neoforge-${NEOFORGE_VERSION}-installer.jar" && java -jar neoforge-installer.jar --installServer && echo 'eula=true' > eula.txt

windows.post_hook: cd {{SERVERLOCATION}}; $xml = [xml](Invoke-WebRequest 'https://maven.neoforged.net/releases/net/neoforged/neoforge/maven-metadata.xml').Content; $ver = $xml.metadata.versioning.release; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://maven.neoforged.net/releases/net/neoforged/neoforge/$ver/neoforge-$ver-installer.jar" -OutFile neoforge-installer.jar; java -jar neoforge-installer.jar --installServer; 'eula=true' | Out-File -Encoding ASCII eula.txt

linux.install: cd {{SERVERLOCATION}} && which java || (echo 'Java not found, please install JRE 21 manually')
linux.post_hook: cd {{SERVERLOCATION}} && VELOCITY_VERSION=$(curl -s https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/velocity | grep -oP '(?<="versions":\[)[^\]]+' | tr ',' '\n' | tr -d '" ' | tail -1) && BUILD=$(curl -s "https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/velocity/versions/${VELOCITY_VERSION}/builds" | grep -oP '(?<="build":)\d+' | tail -1) && wget -O server.jar "https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/velocity/versions/${VELOCITY_VERSION}/builds/${BUILD}/downloads/velocity-${VELOCITY_VERSION}-${BUILD}.jar"

linux.install: cd {{SERVERLOCATION}} && which java || (echo 'Java not found, please install JRE 21 manually')
linux.post_hook: cd {{SERVERLOCATION}} && PURPUR_VERSION=$(curl -s https://api.purpurmc.org/v2/purpur | grep -oP '(?<="versions":\[)[^\]]+' | tr ',' '\n' | tr -d '" ' | tail -1) && BUILD=$(curl -s "https://api.purpurmc.org/v2/purpur/${PURPUR_VERSION}" | grep -oP '(?<="latest":")\d+') && wget -O server.jar "https://api.purpurmc.org/v2/purpur/${PURPUR_VERSION}/${BUILD}/download" && echo 'eula=true' > eula.txt

windows.post_hook: cd {{SERVERLOCATION}}; $proj = (Invoke-WebRequest 'https://api.purpurmc.org/v2/purpur').Content | ConvertFrom-Json; $ver = $proj.versions[-1]; $build = ((Invoke-WebRequest "https://api.purpurmc.org/v2/purpur/$ver").Content | ConvertFrom-Json).builds.latest; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://api.purpurmc.org/v2/purpur/$ver/$build/download" -OutFile server.jar; 'eula=true' | Out-File -Encoding ASCII eula.txt
